data.exact_reserve_text: During 2015 the Syndicate released GBP 95.7m of technical reserves in respect of prior periods (2014: GBP 77.4m), arising predominantly from the Energy, Casualty and Treaty Divisions (2014: primarily from the Marine, Property and Treaty Divisions). These releases were due to favourable claims development on attritional losses during 2015.

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate reported a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 95.7 million in 2015, representing 6.06% of its opening gross claims outstanding. This favourable development was primarily driven by favourable claims experience on attritional losses across the Energy, Casualty, and Treaty Divisions. While several natural and man-made catastrophe events occurred in 2015, including the Tianjin Port explosions, Hurricane Patricia, and UK floods, their impact was contained within catastrophe budgets. Prior year events from 2014, such as the Japan snowfall, US hailstorms and tornadoes, and Hurricane Odile, showed little change in their estimated net losses during 2015, further contributing to the overall reserve release.
